venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 7/7 (MOD MKZ/JK):** Lively Bingo Tuesday on the books. Shift started with great energy; Colombia vs. Switzerland pulled in some early guests. Closer came in at 6pm, opener left a bit after; stage couldn't come in. Great pop for Bingo around 7pm — closer highlighted the bingo cocktails, guests loving the Corpse Reviver #2. MOD supported the closer while the barback handled prep for the week. Stanley Cup grand prize kept folks playing to the end, and one of our regulars won it. Quiet after Bingo, night wrapped smoothly. Kitchen: great ticket times. Favorite moment: a friend of investor Kev came in to celebrate his birthday. Net $2,431 vs. $2,177 target; 62 guests, $39.22 check avg.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 7/7 (MOD MD / Chef KM):** Smooth, down-tempo Tuesday. Usual bingo crowd including a 9-top bachelorette party, with decent food sales in the first half of service. Predictable lull once bingo concluded, followed by two small pops around 9:30pm and 11:30pm to close the night. Kevin held down the kitchen and stayed active on the floor. 86: cider, lassi mix. Maintenance: well 3 chiller / speed rail. Favorite moment: a group of five came in for one round ~9:45pm, stayed past close over a few more rounds, and were thoroughly complimentary of the space and vibe. Comps $29 (1.8%, manager comp, residents). Net $1,635 vs. $1,349 target; 41 guests, $39.88 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 7/7 (AM Maggie & Josh / PM Carey & Lucas):** Great Tuesday. Cafe/AM super steady all day ($922.76); cold brew ready at 9am, tea order back in stock with matcha. D&C PM $6,052.74 — aces in their places; down a barback but Dom, Jordan & Minsu worked tight until the night petered out enough to run one down. Kitchen had a chill day. Events: held Day 1 of High School Success meetings with 25 guests, 12–5pm in Vauxhall ($2,063 event food / $2,400 net event); Josh's lunch spread was a hit, Odessa crushed service, group ran exercises and concluded at 5pm — on to Day 2. Comps $323.70 (4.64%). Favorite moment: everyone in control, no chaos, lots of teamwork and communication. Net $6,975.50 (excl. events) vs. $8,106 target; 160 guests; $9,375.50 including events.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Meh (cooler, damp — break from the heatwave)
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 7/7 (MOD Kyler / Chef Steves):** Another very slow start; bar filled around 8pm while the floor stayed mellow. Picked up around 10 with a steady flow, lots of guests wanting the bar — top sellers Cloudwalk, Native Lion, and Ghost Machine. Emptied out around 11, dying down at midnight; got to celebrate Nick and Kyler's birthday. Door: chilly, damp evening, a welcome break from the heatwave. Snail-paced start (~4 groups by 6:45), approached capacity ~9pm, full at 10, then a rapid descent, hovering ~50% until midnight. Hosted several UK and LA groups; largest party of four just after midnight; one no-show (Talia Marash, 2 @ 6:30). 86: oysters. Comps $43 (industry love + one DNL). Net $3,807 vs. $4,175 target; 98 guests, $40 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 7/7 (MOD Joe / Julian / Chef Vic):** A pretty steady Tuesday. Started with 31 covers and a nice early push; room filled around 8pm and we started a small waitlist not long after. Flow was smooth and all parties were seated in a timely fashion. The GM and executive chef from the soon-to-open Lucky's Steakhouse stopped by for drinks to get familiar with the neighborhood. Julian was on the floor training again, took the lead and crushed it. Room stayed relatively full to the end with a very smooth last call. Busy night for the kitchen. Comps $214 (DK+MB, regular Peter, industry, birthdays, DNL). Favorite moment: meeting a couple who grew up five minutes from Joe's hometown. Net $4,751 vs. $4,583 target; 120 guests, $91.37 check avg.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Cooler weather, bringing in more foot traffic
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 7/7 (MOD Josh / Marcus):** Awesome Tuesday — cooler weather brought foot traffic into the alley. Nice pop around 6:30pm, full by 7:30. Welcomed Haleigh and her mom from D&C East Village, plus Ryan from Denver (joining D&C Denver, excited to onboard). Room wound down around 10pm with a natural last call ~11:30 and clear by midnight. Mariah held down the floor solo; once full, Josh and Marcus jumped in to greet tables and run food/drinks. James and Maria had a fantastic kitchen service with low ticket times. Bar (Alex, Jada, Elliot) kept things smooth and handled an intoxicated guest thoughtfully; two guests at Table 44 DNL'd a couple cocktails. Comps $487.97 (incl. $253.44 community comp, employee discount, DNL, F&F). 82 guests (35 reso / 47 walk-in). Net $3,308.44 vs. $3,448 target.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Hot; afternoon lightning and thunder, no serious rain
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 7/7 (AM Braden / PM James & Marcus):** Pretty good random Tuesday night with lots of walk-ins. Slow morning ($969, 22 guests) gave staff time for cleaning — Braden led a colossal coffee-station project. Evening ($2,647, 71 guests): the Carlas ran the floor solo the entire night and still swept, scrubbed and mopped the coffee alcove; Eryn got out early; Matt (with Aimee's support) cruised through a night that saw nearly all bar seats full a few times. Sun Club slow and forced to an early shutdown by a mid-afternoon lightning storm ($20); Hot Eye closed. No kitchen notes; no events. Comps $208. Favorite moment: Samuel Thomas (who hosted the Sams at Hotel Granada) is staying with us — welcomed him with warm food and a negroni after a tough drive in. Net $3,636 vs. $4,000 target; 93 guests.
